ex.s: Societies all over the world view the concept of an adult as self-supporting and self-directed, because it identifies a point in the life cycle.
ex.t: 全世界的社会的都把“成年人”这一概念视为能够自立和自主，因为它标示了生命周期中的一个节点。

ex.s: Psychologist Robert Turner wrote about this in his book, The Life Cycle, mentioning a stage when kids learn self-direction and mastery. ____35____
ex.t: 心理学家Robert Turner在《生命周期》一书中写到这一点，提到孩子学习自主和掌控的一个阶段。____35____

ex.s: It’s also our job to support adults who need help repairing incomplete life cycles.
ex.t: 支持那些需要帮助以修复不完整生命周期的成年人，也是我们的职责。

ex.s: I ____48____ of entering cycle races until I flew to San Diego to visit my sister.
ex.t: 我____48____参加自行车比赛，直到我飞往圣迭戈看望我姐姐。

ex.s: Cycling is the most economical, sustainable and fun way to explore the city, with its beautiful canals, parks, squares and countless lights.
ex.t: 骑自行车是最经济、可持续且有趣的城市探索方式，这里有美丽的运河、公园、广场和无数的灯光。

ex.s: We all know that cycling is a greatly exercise.
ex.t: 我们都知道骑自行车是一项极好的运动。

ex.s: At 9:30am, the full red/yellow/green signal cycle might be 140 seconds.
ex.t: 早上9:30，完整的红/黄/绿信号周期可能是140秒。

ex.s: When the children are walking or ___59___ (cycle) to school on dark mornings, car drivers can ___60___ (easy) see them.
ex.t: 当孩子们在黑暗的早晨步行或____59____（骑车）上学时，司机能____60____（容易）看到他们。

ex.s: To test the life cycle of a product.
ex.t: 为了测试产品的生命周期。

ex.s: While running regularly can’t make you live forever, the review says it  64 (be) more effective at lengthening life  65 walking, cycling or swimming.
ex.t: 虽然经常跑步不能让你长生不老，但综述说它比步行、骑自行车或游泳更能____64____（是）延长生命____65____。

ex.s: On a bright, warm July afternoon, Mac Hollan, a primary school teacher, was cycling from his home to Alaska with his friends.
ex.t: 在一个阳光明媚、温暖的七月下午，小学老师麦克·霍兰正和他的朋友们从家骑车前往阿拉斯加。

ex.s: Many cities already have elevated cycle paths and I’m sure that these are 5____________________ for many others around the world.
ex.t: 许多城市已经有了高架的自行车道，我相信这些对其他许多城市来说也是值得效仿的范例。

ex.t: A 租自行车 B 步行穿过水下走廊 C 租脚踏船 D 看喷泉表演 E 玩儿童游乐设施 F 赏花。琳琳和玉辉带杰克去北京奥林匹克森林公园。

defs.def: the fact of a series of events being repeated many times, always in the same order 循环

ex.s: Background information A triathlon is a sports competition in which people run, swim and cycle over various distances, depending on age and ability.
ex.t: 背景资料 A triathlon 是一个体育比赛,根据年龄和能力,人们在比赛中跑步,游泳和在不同的距离上循环.

ex.s: According to modern psychology, we must first learn about the “habit cycle”, which works like this: • Firstly, there is a “cue”, an action, event, or situation that acts as a signal to do something.
ex.t: 根据现代心理学，我们必须首先了解习惯循环，它的工作原理如下：首先，有一个提示，即作为信号来触发某种行为的动作、事件或情境。

ex.s: THE HABIT CYCLE ROUTINE REWARD CUE Find the main idea of a paragraph The main idea is sometimes stated in either the opening or closing sentence.
ex.t: 习惯循环：例行程序、奖励、提示。找出段落的主旨大意：主旨大意有时在开头句或结尾句中陈述。
